name: HumanLink
description: Hardware biometric authorization gate for high-risk tool calls via HumanLink protocol (ESP32 U-stick + fingerprint).

sdkUrl.label: SDK URL
sdkUrl.help: Base URL of the HumanLink SDK daemon (default: http://127.0.0.1:8765)

fallback.label: Fallback Policy
fallback.help: What to do when the HumanLink device is unavailable: deny (block), ui (fall back to OpenClaw UI approval), allow (permit execution)

timeoutSeconds.label: Timeout (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.help: How long to wait for biometric response before applying fallback (default: 30)

riskPolicy.label: Risk Policy
riskPolicy.help: Configure which tools require HumanLink authorization
